name: Iron Man

moves.name: Repulsor Blast
moves.description: Palm repulsor shot, scalable from stun to melting steel.

moves.name: Repulsor Barrage
moves.description: Both palms sweeping across multiple targets.

moves.name: Unibeam
moves.description: Chest-mounted beam that hits everything in a line; his biggest single shot.

moves.name: Armored Strike
moves.description: Servo-assisted punch that dents Doom's armor.

moves.name: Flight Dash
moves.description: Boot-repulsor burst to close distance, gain altitude, or escape.

moves.name: Energy Shield
moves.description: Shaped force field that stops one big hit; cannot attack the same round.

moves.name: Scan
moves.description: Spends the round analyzing a target, revealing a weakness and granting Intel; useless against magic.

moves.name: EMP Pulse
moves.description: Disables nearby tech and vehicles for a round; risks his own systems.

moves.name: Magnetic Grapple
moves.description: Pulls or pins a metal foe or object into place.

moves.name: Micro-Missiles
moves.description: Shoulder-launched munitions that wreck cover and vehicles.

moves.name: Summon Spare Armor
moves.description: Calls a spare suit from the Tower to restore armor power; once per fight.

moves.name: Rescue
moves.description: Flies a civilian or downed ally clear of the fight; raises morale.

leitmotif: Driving arpeggiated synth over a hard-rock pulse; thins to a single ticking pulse when armor power runs low.
